fair.name: FAIR
fair.purpose: Scores how easily others can find, open and reuse a published dataset.

crop-ontology.name: Crop Ontology
crop-ontology.purpose: Gives each measured trait a shared name, method and scale.

common-greenhouse-ontology.name: Common Greenhouse Ontology
common-greenhouse-ontology.purpose: Names greenhouse and growth chamber setups in shared terms.

miappe.name: MIAPPE
miappe.purpose: The minimum information checklist for plant phenotyping that repositories ask for.

brapi.name: BrAPI
brapi.purpose: The API plant breeding tools speak, so they can read this experiment directly.

ogc-sensorthings.name: OGC SensorThings
ogc-sensorthings.purpose: An open standard for serving sensor readings to other tools.

openaire-floor.name: OpenAIRE floor
openaire-floor.purpose: The record fields a dataset needs before OpenAIRE can harvest its DOI.
